# Getting help

- Start with the **[FAQ](https://github.com/pinkmoneyx-bigguys/flux-torrent#-faq)** in the README.
- Found a bug or have an idea? **[Open an issue](https://github.com/pinkmoneyx-bigguys/flux-torrent/issues/new/choose)** — the forms ask for what helps the most.
- For questions about BitTorrent itself, qBittorrent's [wiki](https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent/wiki) is a great resource: Flux runs on the same engine.
